nina: Heads-upwe need a clear, non-alarming flow in Console for v1 deprecation that covers probes, audit logs, and a tenant-facing escape hatch. Quick ideas?

dan: three phases imo: Preview (read-only estimates), Simulate (run a sandboxed probe/simulator), Rollout (enforce). Keep language neutral, show concrete numbers not vague warnings.

priy: For Simulate, prefer two modes: shadow (identical requests forked to candidate model, no impact) and micro-live (0.1% real traffic). Add an opt-in header for micro-live: `X-Compat-Sim: live`.

ops-max: Telemetry plan: emit `compat_phase`, `sim_mode`, `probe_id`, `routed_model`, `route_reason`, `error_delta_pct`, `sample_n`. Also sample full traces for mismatch cases. Wire these into our tracing stack.

billbot: Billing rules: we bill the model that executed. During Preview/Simulate show an "Estimated monthly delta" computed by billing-service. We'll return `estimate_delta` and `token_factor` if tokenization differs.

nina: Console UX: show a compact timeline card with phase badge, estimated cost delta, and a tiny sparklines for 5xx and latency. Add a "Run simulation" button and a "Request audit" action.

dan: Simulation specifics: shadow by default at 100% for X minutes, micro-live at configurable percent. Keep default micro-live at 0.1% and ramp to 1% if confidence high. Return confidence as low/med/high.

priy: Also show a short anonymized sample of mismatched prompts (hash ids, scrubbed text) so teams can eyeball regressions. Limit to 20 samples per run.

ops-max: Escape hatch: automatic rollback if 5xx rate > 3x baseline OR absolute increase > 0.5% for 10 minutes. Console toggle to enable immediate rollback via admin API.

billbot: We'll publish an estimator endpoint `GET /estimate_delta?project=&candidate_model=` that returns a stringified estimate + confidence. Console can call it during Preview.

nina: Audit trail: every phase transition generates an audit entry human readable, e.g. "2026-03-20T14:22: Probe started by nina (probe id pid-42). Mode=shadow+live(0.1%)." Keep audit retention 90 days and expose in Console.

dan: Add headers on response to surface routing to SDKs: `X-Routed-Model: model-v2-202603` and `X-Compatibility: partial` when behavior may change. That reduces surprise for client devs.

priy: Telemetry schema PR will include field docs and scrubber rules. We must not log raw user ids or full prompts. Hash user ids and remove PII from samples.

ops-max: For debugging, we'll export a daily compact sample of mismatches (200 items) to s3://compat-dbg/<date>/ with 14 day retention. Include scrub notes in runbook for Legal.

nina: Owners: dan -> routing + simulation infra, priy -> Console + samples UI, ops-max -> telemetry/runbook, billbot -> estimator API. I'll open a GH issue with this thread.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: feature/compat-sim -> staging (sha: c7d8e9f) :rocket:

dan: QA checklist: 1) headers emitted on all code paths; 2) billing id on routing events; 3) probe header controls behavior; 4) scrubber validated; 5) rollback toggle triggers admin API.

priy: UX note: avoid red unless Rollout triggered. Use blue for Preview, amber for Simulate, green for Rollout. Keep copy concrete: "Requests may be routed to compatible variants. Billing reflects the model that served your requests."

nina: Thanks team. Please drop PR links back into this thread and tag me for the runbook review. :thumbsup:
